correctness.rationale: Translation to a code containing 0000 converts nonzero supports into a pairwise-intersecting antichain on four points. An elementary size-by-size classification bounds this antichain by four and identifies all equality cases. The five normalized maxima are exactly the five codeword-translates of C_*, giving a free 16-element translation orbit. Hamming and XOR statements follow directly. A separate exhaustive verifier checks every subset of the 16-word space and all claimed counts and orbit data.
